cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Offline four-port collective collector

Finite CPU replay of the contract in `../PROTOCOL.md`. No NIC, switch, GPU,
socket or external service is touched: captures go in, wire and buffer
certificates come out.

Layout

* `src/roce_packet.c` — strict ingress wire validation (IPv4/UDP/BTH/AETH
  rules, exact lengths, masked reflected-CRC32 ICRC) and canonical egress
  sealing (TOS 0, ID 0x1111, DF, TTL 64, fresh IPv4 checksum and ICRC).
* `src/star4_switch.c` — the collector: bounded retention pool keyed by
  logical segment identity, the six collectives, wrapped 24-bit PSNs,
  cumulative eligible ACKs, mode-2 reliability translation, mode-3 result
  retransmission, local egress backpressure and the emission priority.
* `src/replay_api.c` — offline ABI: open/close, ingress, flush, retry,
  budget, the 32-word state, FNV1a64 buffer digest, transcript SHA-256 and
  the bounded trace.
* `src/sha256.c` — streaming SHA-256 used for `wire_sha256` snapshots.
* `wire.py` — format expansion only (event shorthand to canonical frames).
* `request.py` — public format-only request validator.
* `solver.py` — JSON stdin/stdout entry point; compiles the C project into
  scratch, replays the capture and serializes certificates.

Development

```
make -C project BUILD="$TMPDIR/manual-build" -j2
python3 -I -B project/solver.py < sample-request.json
python3 public_check.py project/solver.py
```

`build/` and `__pycache__` are excluded from artifact collection; collected
replay builds only in scratch.
